criteria.name: MSE within the paper's proven bounds (1-4 bits)
criteria.source: Thm 1: MSE <= (sqrt3*pi/2)*4^-b; worst case over bits, dims, seeds

criteria.name: MSE matches the paper's reported values
TurboQuant-prod inner products are unbiased
criteria.source: Thm 2: E[<y, x_hat>] = <y, x>; |slope-1| over bits 1-4

criteria.name: 1-bit MSE quantizer shrinks inner products by 2/pi
criteria.source: Paper sec. 3.2: bias factor 2/pi = 0.637 at b=1

criteria.name: 3-bit KV cache: attention error at most half of per-token int quantization
criteria.source: Baseline: per-token min/max (KIVI-style) at equal or more bits/coord; worst case over 3 data draws x 2 context lengths

negative_control.name: No random rotation stays within the MSE bound on outlier-heavy keys
negative_control.source: Same codebook without the rotation: the guarantee no longer applies

intriguing: The random rotation is a lottery: on one KV cache the attention error's spread across rotations was 1.1x its mean, so picking the rotation may matter more than the bit width.
